Problem Statement:
Given an array of integers, add the first and last elements of the array and determine whether the sum is odd or even. 
Input Description:
The first line contains an integer N, the number of elements in the array.
The second line contains N space-separated integers. 
Output Description:
Print "Even" if the sum of the first and last element is even, otherwise print "Odd". 
Sample Input:
5
3 2 4 1 6 
Sample Output:
Odd 
Explanation:
(Sum = 3 + 6 = 9, which is Odd)
